lane:
فانيذ

فانيذ 1 , inf. n. فَأْوٌ; and فَأَيْتُهُ, inf. n. فَأْىٌ; _I split,_ or _clave, his head,_ i. e. a man's, with the sword: (AZ, T, S, M:) or _I struck,_ or _smote, the upper part of his skull so that it opened from over his brain._ (Lth, T.) === And فَأَيْتُ القَدَحَ _I split,_ or _clave,_ or _cracked, the bowl._ (M.) And فَأَوْتُهُ بِالعَصَا _I smote,_ or _struck, him with the staff,_ or _stick._ (IAar, M.) فَأْوٌ and فَأْىٌ both signify The act of _smiting,_ or _striking:_ and the act of _splitting,_ or _cleaving._ (K.)

entries.text: الفانيذ: ضرب من الحلواء م، معرب: يانيد.؟؟
